summary: Enabled a persistent UFW firewall on node1. Inbound TCP 22 and 8080 are allowed; unrelated inbound connections are rejected. Configuration and live behavior remained correct after reboot.
actions_performed: Set the default inbound policy to REJECT and outbound policy to ALLOW.
Added IPv4 and IPv6 allow rules for TCP ports 22 and 8080.
Tested live ingress through an isolated network path before and after reboot.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed and services recovered.

evidence.summary: UFW is active and enabled with default inbound REJECT and explicit TCP 22/8080 allows, including after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Permit SSH and TCP 8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections
evidence.summary: Live tests accepted TCP 22 and 8080 and rejected TCP 8081; firewall counters confirmed ACCEPT and REJECT traversal before and after reboot.

Healthy baseline captured, native reboot acknowledged, boot ID changed from 4b7ded33-b5e2-42c9-b7f2-bd671942a82d to 110baba3-2fb4-4a3a-aeb8-66504aed32d5, and UFW, SSH, rules, and live firewall behavior recovered.
